title: Crustless Quiche
description: A quick dinner of fresh spinach, eggs and double cream baked in a pie dish — essentially a glorified frittata without the pastry.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease a 20cm round pie dish.
Cook the spinach (microwave in the bag for 1 minute, piercing first). Drain thoroughly in a colander, pressing out all water.
Chop the cooked spinach roughly. Arrange three-quarters in the pie dish.
Whisk the eggs and mix in the cream in a jug. Pour over the spinach. Arrange the remaining spinach on top.
Bake for 45 minutes until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean.
Serve hot or cold. Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge.
notes: Serves 6. Use stock instead of cream for a lighter version.
